lines: I am still finding my place here. You made sure there was a here to find it in.
I had no station, no trade, just a door to hide behind. You kept that door standing.
I do not have much here yet, but you protected the life I might build.
The bell gave everyone time to reach shelter.
You chose courage when panic would have been easier.
The houses are still standing because people stood together.
I saw the attackers break against neighbors who refused to run.
The gate held. I still cannot believe it held.
You made room for frightened people behind your shield.
I carried water and bandages because you kept the path open.
No one asked what trade I had while we were defending the square.
The village survived because everyone found something useful to do.
I will help rebuild what you protected.
You did not chase glory. You stayed where people needed you.
I remember the silence after the last attacker fled.
The bell sounds different after you have heard it call people to safety.
I watched strangers become neighbors at the gate.
You gave this village another morning.
I am proud that I helped, even from the back of the line.
Thank you for keeping my unfinished life safe.
